title: Law to protect community buildings from tax lien sales
summary: This bill would bar the city from selling tax liens on properties like affordable housing and nonprofits that serve at least 100 households with essential services such as energy, water or childcare. Instead the Department of Finance must offer installment payment plans, counseling and referrals to help owners resolve unpaid taxes and charges. The department must report annually to the Council, by September 30, on the program's use and outcomes.
